newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch bonds close higher but below day's peaks.
newsitem.headline: Dutch bonds close higher but below day's peaks.

text.p: 1630 GMT - Dutch bonds end higher but below intra-day peaks reached when March Bund future broke through 104.00 level. Cash trade said thin, focusing on new ten-year benchmark and 2023
bond. Market led by heavy futures trade. Lengthening continues.
* Feb 2002 +0.05 at 116.62/72, yielding 4.46 percent at bid.
* Yield spread versus Jan 2002 Bund -3 basis points.
* Feb 2007 +0.14 at 102.96/103.04, for a bid yield of 5.36 pct.
* Dutch 5.75 Feb 2007 yields 0.90 points over Dutch Feb 2002.
* 10-yr yld spread vs Jan 2007 Bund steady at -12 basis points.
* Jan 2023s +0.35 at 118.70/90, 6.05 percent yield at bid.
